bugs.error_message: FlightGear shows drone model but no motion despite packets arriving
bugs.root_cause: NPS defaults to GUI protocol (FGNetGUI, version 8). FlightGear --native-fdm expects FDM protocol (FGNetFDM, version 24). Without --fg_fdm flag, every packet is silently discarded by FG version check.
bugs.fix: Added --fg_fdm to simsitl command in sim_anton.py when --fg flag is used

bugs.error_message: PermissionError: [Errno 1] Operation not permitted — sending UDP to 192.168.65.254
bugs.root_cause: Devcontainer firewall has OUTPUT DROP default policy. HOST_IP is set to the Docker bridge gateway (172.24.0.1), not the Mac host (192.168.65.254). Traffic to host.docker.internal is blocked.
bugs.fix: Patched init-firewall.sh to resolve host.docker.internal at startup and add iptables rules to allow INPUT/OUTPUT for that IP. Temporary fix via sudo iptables for current session.

bugs.error_message: NPS FG packets sent to 255.255.255.255 (broadcast) instead of Mac host — no data arrives
bugs.root_cause: nps_flightgear_init() uses inet_addr() which only handles dotted-decimal IPs. Passing 'host.docker.internal' returns INADDR_NONE (broadcast address). NPS appeared to send but packets went nowhere useful.
bugs.fix: Resolve hostname to IP in Python with socket.gethostbyname() before passing to simsitl. Added try/except fallback to hardcoded 192.168.65.254.

bugs.root_cause: Passed CONF_XML as 'paparazzi/conf/...' per the workspace CLAUDE.md example, but build_fw.sh runs 'make -C /workspace/paparazzi' so the path resolves relative to paparazzi/ and became paparazzi/paparazzi/conf/...
bugs.fix: Pass CONF_XML relative to the paparazzi dir: 'conf/airframes/ENAC/conf_enac.xml' (matches build_fw.sh's own header example).

bugs.error_message: AP build: duplicate case values in autopilot_static.c (AP_MODE_RATE_DIRECT==3 clashes with AP_MODE_KILL==3 from generated header)
bugs.root_cause: Makefile.ac generation caches by mtime: generator only overwrites Makefile.ac if it is older than source XMLs. After an NPS build, Makefile.ac has USE_GENERATED_AUTOPILOT=TRUE only in the NPS block. AP build reuses this stale file, so autopilot_static.c is compiled alongside the generated autopilot header, causing duplicate case value errors.
bugs.fix: build_fw.sh now always deletes var/aircrafts/<AC>/Makefile.ac before each build, forcing the generator to regenerate it for the current target. This ensures USE_GENERATED_AUTOPILOT=TRUE appears in the correct target block regardless of which target was built last.

bugs.error_message: pprz_version.h:58 error: invalid type argument of unary '*' (have 'int') in PPRZ_VERSION_INT, when compiling autopilot.c during `build_active.sh ... fast`. Intermittent: only when autopilot.o is actually recompiled.
bugs.root_cause: The fast path runs `make -C paparazzi/sw/airborne all` directly, bypassing Makefile.ac which computes/exports GIT_DESC, PPRZ_VER, PPRZ_VER_MAJOR/MINOR/PATCH. sw/airborne/Makefile:59-64 then emits -DPPRZ_VER_MAJOR= (empty) into CFLAGS, so PPRZ_VERSION_INT expands to ( * 10000 + * 100 + ). Only autopilot.c expands that macro, so the error is latent until an edit forces autopilot.o to rebuild ('when more files are affected').
bugs.fix: build_active.sh fast block now recreates the version vars (mirroring Makefile.ac, including the PPRZ_VER_PATCH=0 guard since v7.0_unstable has no patch field) and passes GIT_SHA1/GIT_DESC/PPRZ_VER/PPRZ_VER_MAJOR/MINOR/PATCH on the make command line.

bugs.error_message: guidance_mfc SITL_PRINT z_sp printed 0.000 forever in NAV mode (MFC->INDI stack); throttle stuck, no altitude tracking
bugs.root_cause: Bespoke guidance_mfc_run_vert read gv->z_ref, but z_ref/z_sp are only populated as a side-effect of guidance_v_run()/guidance_v_from_nav() (which copies nav.nav_altitude -> z_sp -> z_ref). The MFC stack replaced guidance_v_run with the bespoke entry point, so z_ref was never updated and stayed 0. NAV mode WAS entering (the print fired) — not a mode problem.
bugs.fix: Refactored guidance_mfc into a standard mutually-exclusive guidance variant providing the generic plug functions guidance_v_run_pos/speed/accel + guidance_h_run_pos/speed/accel + _run_enter. The generic guidance_v/guidance_h drivers now fill gv->z_ref / gh->ref.pos from nav before calling us, so the reference is valid. Verified in NPS: z_sp ramps 0 -> -2.0 m.

bugs.error_message: MFC vertical throttle command = -nan in NPS once z_sp was correctly populated (MFC->INDI stack)
bugs.root_cause: mfc_core's shared mfc.sample_time was 0, so mfc_siso_run() divided by sample_time (and sample_time^2) -> inf/NaN. mfc_core_init() is only called by stabilization_mfc_init() (and guidance_indi_init when GUIDANCE_INDI_THRUST_MFC). In the MFC->INDI stack the MFC side is the GUIDANCE, so neither ran and the core was never initialised. Masked before because z_sp==0 kept the estimator inputs trivially zero.
bugs.fix: guidance_mfc_init() now calls mfc_core_init(1.f / PERIODIC_FREQUENCY), mirroring guidance_indi.c:250. Verified: throttle is finite. NOTE: throttle is still noisy/oscillating at startup — that is the untuned MFC estimator transient (GZ gains are starting points), a tuning task, not a code bug.
bugs.resolution_note: API since renamed (2026-06-11): the per-module timing refactor replaced mfc_core_init() with per-axis mfc_siso_init(); guidance_mfc_init() now calls mfc_siso_init(&mfc_gx/gy/gz, 1/PERIODIC_FREQUENCY). Root cause (uninitialised sample_time -> divide-by-zero) and fix intent are unchanged.

bugs.error_message: MFC vertical estimator F_k stays 0; v_thrust.z/th_cmd.z print 0; never lifts off (MFC->INDI stack)
bugs.root_cause: mfc.time pinned at one sample period (0.002s) every cycle because mfc_core_start() was wired into guidance_h_run_enter(), and guidance_h_from_nav() calls guidance_h_nav_enter()->guidance_h_run_enter() EVERY cycle while !in_flight (guidance_h.c:393). The estimator gate mfc.time>0.1 (mfc_core.c:83) therefore never opened, so F_k stayed 0.
bugs.fix: Made guidance_h_run_enter() a documented no-op; only guidance_v_run_enter() starts the shared mfc_core clock. Verified mfc.time then grows and F_k develops.
bugs.resolution_note: SUPERSEDED by bug-033 (2026-06-11). The v-only-starts / h-no-op split was a workaround for the GLOBAL shared clock. After timing moved into each SISO module, the split was removed: guidance_v_run_enter() resets gz, guidance_h_run_enter() resets gx/gy.

bugs.error_message: MFC vertical F_k and command blow up to +/-infinity on the ground after bug-030 fix
bugs.root_cause: The MFC algebraic estimator is effectively an integrator: cmd[k] ~= cmd[k-1] + (ydd_ref - kp^2*err)/alpha. On the ground z_meas==0 while the altitude reference ramps, so err never decays -> integrator windup -> F_k diverges. mfc_siso_run accepts in_flight but ignores it (mfc_core.c:95). The stabilizer avoids this because attitude error ~0 (plant responds); vertical guidance on the ground does not.
bugs.fix: Gate the estimator on in_flight in guidance_mfc_vert: while !in_flight, re-latch the clock (keeps mfc.time < 0.1 gate), zero cmd history, and output GUIDANCE_MFC_GZ_NOMINAL_HOVER_THROTTLE; run MFC only in flight (fresh start at takeoff). v_thrust.z now steady 0.30 on ground.
bugs.resolution_note: SUPERSEDED by bug-033 (2026-06-11). The in_flight ground-gating + per-cycle clock re-latch was removed; guidance_mfc_vert() now runs raw MFC every cycle whenever gz is enabled. Ground windup protection intentionally dropped per user request.

bugs.error_message: Vehicle won't take off with clean 0.30 MFC throttle; in_flight never trips
bugs.root_cause: User edit `v_thrust.z = thrust->sp.thrust_f[THRUST_AXIS_Z]` feeds a normalised throttle (0.30) into the WLS thrust objective indi_v[3], which lives in PPRZ*effectiveness units. Stock mapping: th_cmd.z=0.30*9600=2880, Bwls[3][i]=g1_thrust/INDI_G_SCALING=-1.5/1000=-0.0015, hover objective = sum 2880*(-0.0015) ~= -17.3. So indi_v[3] needs ~-17.3; edit feeds +0.30 (~58x too small AND wrong sign) -> WLS commands motors ~off -> no takeoff -> in_flight never set. Not newtons; nothing converts to force.
bugs.fix: DIAGNOSED ONLY (user's intentional edit, not reverted). Options: (1) revert to stock v_thrust.z += th_cmd.z*Bwls[3][i]*act_thrust_mat[2][i] [recommended]; or (2) make guidance output the indi_v[3]-space value (~-17 at hover) and retune GZ_ALPHA + sign. Awaiting user choice.
bugs.resolution_note: RESOLVED 2026-06-11 (user-confirmed: MFC Z guidance flies perfectly smooth in NPS). The absolute-thrust edit (stabilization_indi.c:741 v_thrust.z = thrust_f) was RETAINED, i.e. option (2) from the diagnosis: guidance outputs an indi_v[3]-space thrust and GZ was retuned so it enters the WLS objective at the correct scale. Not reverted to stock.

bugs.root_cause: bug-030 (v-only clock start / h no-op) and bug-031 (per-cycle clock re-latch + in_flight ground gating) were workarounds for the GLOBAL shared mfc clock. After moving timing into each SISO module (per-axis time/sample_time/start_time + mfc_siso_reset), those workarounds are obsolete.
bugs.fix: guidance_v_run_enter resets gz only; guidance_h_run_enter resets gx/gy (removed the deliberate no-op); guidance_mfc_vert now runs MFC every cycle whenever gz enabled (removed the in_flight gate, per-cycle reset, and zero-cmd ground branch) with nominal-hover fallback only when gz disabled. NOTE: removes ground windup protection (raw MFC, user-requested).

bugs.error_message: stabilization_indi.c thrust path hacked (v_thrust.z = thrust->sp.thrust_f[Z]) to consume guidance_mfc's physical thrust, corrupting the generic INDI stabilizer for non-MFC users
bugs.root_cause: guidance_mfc emits the vertical thrust in physical indi_v[3]-space units (~-17 at hover). To make it work, stock INDI's Bwls thrust line was bypassed. That edit is downstream-specific and should live in guidance, not in the shared stabilizer.
bugs.fix: Reverted stabilization_indi.c to stock (v_thrust.z += th_cmd.z*Bwls[3][i]*act_thrust_mat[2][i]). Added GUIDANCE_MFC_THRUST_TO_PPRZ (+ GUIDANCE_MFC_THRUST_PPRZ_SCALE = 1/sum(Bwls[3][i])) in guidance_mfc.c: when TRUE, convert physical thrust to a paparazzi-scaled (0:MAX_PPRZ) int via th_sp_from_thrust_i so the stock INDI Bwls path round-trips exactly (scale=-166.67 for ANTON: G1 thrust row -1.5 x4 / INDI_G_SCALING 1000). Default FALSE emits raw float for stabilization_mfc.c, which now reads thrust->sp.thrust_f[Z] directly into its pseudo-inverse. ANTON_MFC airframe sets THRUST_TO_PPRZ=TRUE.
